_note: Analog panel meter (moving-coil d'Arsonval movement). Terminal A (+), B (-). Engine device in bench-meters.js. state.deflection (0..1) drives needle angle; params.fullScale sets scale label (e.g. '5V', '1A'). Live needle rendered via getDeviceState in bw-circuit-ui; SVG shows static mid-deflection as palette thumbnail.
